top_band: medium grey-blue horizontal top surface with back highlight, central dark slot, and front edge highlight (rows 16-21)
evidence: Reading down a central column of the main engine block: rows 16-21 form a 6-row horizontal top band (row 16 back highlight, rows 17-20 mid-grey surface with a dark slot at row 19, and row 21 bright front-edge highlight) with the two pipes set back behind row 21; rows 22-23 form a 2-row dark eave shadow, and rows 24-47 form the vertical front face with the circular core and rivets.

style.evidence: The metal casing, vertical pipes, and central purple orb are composed of large unshaded geometric flat fills (over 10x20 pixels of a single flat grey on the front face, flat vertical stripes on the pipes, and unshaded concentric rings on the core) with a pure black line along the left and bottom edges, lacking the surface grain, organic shading, and tile density of the Beodeul reference props.
